answer: Because the derivation is bound to the ripple signature, the vault gate rejects a mismatch, and the signal checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 41 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 106 aliases means authoring 106 texts that each match their own nonce. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
